verdict.rationale: Bitbucket documents connecting to "market-leading partner tools" across AI code generation, security, testing and monitoring. It also describes installing a third-party integration (Snyk) from the repository's Security tab, so third-party integrations can be installed in-product. However, no marketplace or app directory for browsing and installing integrations is ever named or described. Missing for 10: an explicitly documented marketplace/app directory, a description of how apps are browsed, installed and managed, evidence of catalog breadth beyond Snyk, and independent or hands-on corroboration.
